off since then.But not visited to any doctor.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPt had h\/o cough (on \u0026amp;off ) with sputum since 1yr but not visited to any doctor.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENow Since 7 days pt is having vomiting (10 episodes, bilious)and dragging time of left sided loin pain with swelling.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPt went to outside hospital on 14\/5\/23.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOn 14\/5\/23 @ admission\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPt c\/c\/c Bp 130\/80\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;
